script_text: Aries, hold onto your fire, because this week the Moon forces a hard choice between your heart and your career. Monday through Wednesday, the New Moon conjuncts your 7th House of partnership, triggering intense romantic clarity with your partner. You will feel sudden pressure to commit or conclude a relationship. However, Venus squares your Sun directly, creating a Mars-ruled affair of intense ego rather than truth. Mid-week shifts as the Sun trines Jupiter in your 5th House, sparking serious financial luck. Later, Mars enters your 6th House, turning your daily grind into a power struggle for money. Saturday night offers a truly private resolution to that public tension. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House. Tuesday is your worst day due to that Moon square. Sign one important contract before Friday, then ignore minor emotional noise. Follow for daily updates.
